question: Dilwara Temples in Mount Abu, Rajasthan, are associated with which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is **Jain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Dilwara Temples or Delvada Temples **are a collection of **svetambara Jain temples** situated in Sirohi District, Rajasthan's sole hill station, some** 212 kilometres from the Mount Abu town.**
 
• The **earliest were allegedly created **or at least funded by** Vastupala, **a Jain minister of **Dholka**, and were constructed by Bhima-1. Vastapul Tejpal, a minister for the** Bhima,Chalukyas of Gujrath king,** erected these Jain temples.
 
• Some experts also think that the **Dilwara Jain Temples is architecturally superior **to the Taj Mahal. It is one of the best Jain temples known around the world for its** amazing architecture **and magnificent marble stone carvings. 
 
• **Jains hold the same reincarnational beliefs** as Hindus and Buddhists. **One's karma** determines how often they will experience birth, death, and reincarnation. **Jains have the view that injuring living **creatures results in negative karma. Jains must adhere to the strict nonviolent ethic of **ahimsa in order to avoid creating negative karma. ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhism, one of the largest religions in the world, **with origins that go back 2,500 years in India. **Buddhists hold that enlightenment, or nirvana, **can be attained by meditation, hard work—both spiritual and physical—and good conduct. They also hold that human life is** one of suffering.**
 
• **Guru Nanak (1469–1539)** founded Sikhism, which was afterwards administered by nine additional Gurus in order. Sikhs think a single spirit lived inside each of the **ten human Gurus.**
 
• Many academics believe that** Hinduism is the oldest religion** in the world, with origins and practises stretching back more than 4,000 years. **Hinduism is the third most popular religion** in the world today, after Islam and Christianity, with around 900 million adherents. India is home to over** 95% of all Hindus in the globe. **
